modules.name: Neural Trajectory Pipeline
modules.summary: Generate branched video trajectories, infer pseudo-actions with the matching IDM, and filter action coherence.
nativeInputs: shared task asset bundle for robot, object and scene lineage
768x432 four-tile conditioning image
task-specific Cosmos Predict2 LoRA, its separately gated base/tokenizer, and the verified reconstructed native checkpoint
pinned T5-11B prompt encoder or hash-verified native prompt embedding manifest
fine-tuned GR00T-Dreams IDM checkpoint plus the packaged training statistics
limitations: Generated camera metadata is an intended trajectory derived from conditioning calibration and IDM motion, not a pixel-geometry measurement.
Every new input dataset must supply a verified dataset-to-robot-base rotation; an identity transform may not be guessed from position magnitudes.
The supplied capture has a physical wrist under the JPEG key `left`; every run must bind the audited MP4-to-JPEG identity artifact.
Qualitative world-model findings are retained as non-blocking review observations unless the upstream repository adds them to its authoritative filter.
goldenRequirements: conditioning frame and source camera layout
locked IDM checkpoint plus materialized exact training stats
held-out real demonstrations and expected filter results
integrityGates: require the IDM dumper patch and record its applied commit/digest
verify every checkpoint file against components/neural_trajectory/asset-lock.json
materialize stats.json only from the locked IDM experiment metadata and verify its semantic digest
assert stitched frame count and explicit 16 fps encoding
require exact 1,599-key coverage after PEFT injection; reject missing or unexpected DiT keys
verify positive and negative prompt embeddings against their prompt-bound manifest
preserve raw gripper vote alongside postprocessed state
reject nonzero action[9:12] as IDM leakage; intentional zero rotation is valid for this fixed-orientation task
require a checksummed dataset-to-robot-base rotation before canonical action export
treat C1-C3 as action-coherence only, never task-success evidence
report physics-replay readiness separately from native Neural Trajectory acceptance

expected identity reconstruction and calibration metrics

report calibration residuals and observability; never hide regularized wrist translation

record whether any background pixels were generated rather than copied

visual randomization assets and camera contract
task profile

validate per-chunk manifest, episode/frame counts and uploaded artifacts
preserve raw MimicGen HDF5 because rendering requires its joint state
mark SART failure as degraded; Data Engine must not silently promote fallback gen.hdf5
retain visual-randomization and physics sample logs per episode
preserve source action gripper commands; infer from finger positions only when source actions are absent
select action profiles by the controller that encoded each artifact, never by the MimicGen producer label
preserve native action values and reject source-manifest/profile scale conflicts
reject converted cube demonstrations unless both open and close supervision remain after resampling
normalize runtime articulation quaternions to wxyz before trajectory math and reject excessive FK/TCP disagreement
compose live world-to-base, parent-link, randomized sensor and USD-optical transforms for every rendered camera row
checksum-gate the exact OmniReset FR3v2.1 and RGB-lab table assets before rendering
apply the full OmniReset camera, enclosure, floor, lighting, renderer and material randomization contract
render Cube state replay inside the exact pinned RL-Teacher RGB task; task-sized table proxies and separately reimplemented visual randomization are forbidden
preserve the exact task source, selected profile, seed, reset-event configuration, and checksummed assets; capture live camera samples without inventing unavailable upstream material-sample telemetry
enforce the OmniReset 50/40/10 visual-profile mixture when validating population-scale exports
resolve generation and render assets from the same task asset bundle; reject a module-local robot, cube, SysID posterior, table or camera substitution
